finding: An independently authored master's thesis from King Faisal University (Omar ibn Abdullah al-Eid, academic year 1437–1438 AH) cites al-Farra's Ma'ani al-Qur'an at vol. 3, p. 296 for this poem and explicitly reports the Ma'ani wording ها أنت in place of هل أنت. This corroborates the IslamWeb electronic witness's volume/page locator and variant. It does not identify the exact edition used by the thesis, prove that this is the same pagination as KSU's bare (377), or establish al-Farra's authorial reading.

source_anchors.source: KSU master's thesis hosted as Quranpedia attachment

note 8 cites Ma'ani al-Qur'an (377) and prints هل أنت

interpretation: Treat the thesis as secondary corroboration of a cited vol.3 p.296 reading, not as substitute for the primary page. No equivalence between page 296 and KSU's bare page 377 has been demonstrated.
